cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C5 alkyl-sulfate chassis - Sodium Coco-Sulfate @4 is the only prominent strong anionic, with two prominent buffers (Coco-Glucoside @2, Sodium Cocoamphoacetate @5) and no reinforcing route (C3, C4, C5). The glucoside leading the list is the buffering the convention already reads; it does not move the value to C6 because a prominent strong anionic exists.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful system (cationic guar @12) plus light routes (Glycerin @3, Panthenol @7, weak refatters @10, @11, @13, @14). C2 not met (no silicone/payload lipid, no pearlizer). Guar sits after the sub-1 % actives (Panthenol @7, Niacinamide @8, Tocopherol @9), so low is the realistic neighbor.
